scope: fresh owned guest profile; unpredictable article fixture in the owned browser tab; real Chat opening, same-conversation follow-up, and post-reload new conversation

questions.opening: Read the unique opening check code from the article on my current tab. What are the three workflow stages in order? Include the exact code.
questions.same_conversation_followup: Read the unique follow-up check code from the article on my current tab and name the heading directly above the check codes. Include the exact code.
questions.post_reload_new_conversation: Same follow-up question after a real panel reload; the run used a new conversation identity.

failure_observation_interpretation: This field is populated on the successful path after each turn. Its final value describes the post-reload follow-up answer. answerMatchesPublicStages and answerStagesInOrder are opening-question diagnostics; false is expected for the different follow-up question. The success assertions for this turn require terminal completion, unpredictable code, and fixture heading, all true.
limitations: This tested the exact v0.2.471 Store ZIP loaded unpacked with a candidate key adaptation in a fresh hosted guest profile; it is not a Chrome Web Store installed-copy observation.
The CDP observer attached after panel load; requests before attachment are outside the observation.
This is bounded Chat evidence and does not establish broad Chat or extension health.
